spec_match.rationale: Calls Iterator.zipKeyed with an object of series — the exact keyed variant — and inspects the spec's OrdinaryObjectCreate(null) row prototype.

interactive.rationale: One button merges three fresh randomised series through the real API into a rendered table plus a prototype inspection readout.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index blurb matches exactly what the page runs and shows.

edge_cases.rationale: The null-prototype consequence (no hasOwnProperty) is demonstrated and the absent-API path shows the real TypeError.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6249068542164992 plus the exact tc39.es spec section.

conformance.rationale: The suite's zipkeyed-null-prototype-rows assertion pins the same contract the page inspects.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: merge clicked; real TypeError surfaced with honest banner; console/network clean; both classes screenshotted.

telemetry_health.rationale: Probe and per-action asserts record supported flag and outcome (rows/threw) in details.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; proto callout is ivory-on-black-border panel; table uses bg-paper.

accessibility.rationale: Button 44px, log and proto are role=status live regions, table has scoped column headers and aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP matrix: overflow 0 on both classes; three-column table fits 360px with wrapping. Harness responsive-check confirms ok on both classes after the same-origin failure-scoping fix (Codex review round 1).

openQuestions.title: Verify the success-path semantics on Chrome 153+
openQuestions.detail: This runner is Chromium 141 where Iterator.zip/zipKeyed are absent even behind --js-flags=--js-joint-iteration (verified), so only the honest-failure paths could be observed live. The success-path expectations (row shapes, strict TypeError, null-prototype rows, IteratorCloseAll) are transcribed from the Stage 4 spec algorithms; run the page and the conformance suite on Chrome 153+ or a V8 with the flag to confirm the engine agrees.

guidanceConsulted.query: interactive code playground editable inputs run button live output table accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Real form controls with labels drive runs; results land in status regions/tables with text semantics, not colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: labelled text inputs/selects, 44px buttons, aria-live result logs, tables with scoped headers; unsupported outcomes are real thrown errors, never simulations.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx modern-web-guidance@latest search run 2026-08-09; no zip-specific guide exists, general control/async guidance applied.

summary: Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CDP: every control driven; the engine lacks Iterator.zip/zipKeyed even behind the flag, so all outcomes are the real thrown TypeErrors with honest banners (no simulation); console/network clean; both viewport classes inspected.
